skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic knowledge of data querying, database design; understand and apply basic principles of the data management application development process.

Ability to design and build databases according to standard normalization forms. Ability to perform simple tasks using database query languages such as relational algebra, SQL, etc. Ability to think about query optimization methods. Ability to approach different database models. Ability to analyze, advise, and support the digital transformation process in terms of data digitization.

Ability to work independently or actively, effectively participate in group activities. Ability to organize group activities. Social responsibility and professional ethics in the field of Information Management Systems.
Basic understanding and usage of MS SQL Server.

Ability to build databases according to standard normalization forms and apply basic principles of the database design process to operational activities; ability to extract data for analysis and synthesis to support decision-making processes.
Ability to analyze, synthesize, and optimize data queries and data integrity.
Understanding and applying data security and data integrity principles.
Ability to solve problems related to database management and design.
Ability to critically analyze and evaluate database-related issues.
Effective communication skills in group settings and presentations.
